features.feature: Single global ~/.claude/agents as sole source for all Lattice agent prompt templates
Symlink target resolves from running CLI package templates/agents (robust for npm -g and local dev paths)
lattice init writes 0 agent files into project (claude/all profiles)
Normal lattice init detects existing project-local managed agent files and WARNs only (never silently deletes)
lattice init --upgrade explicitly migrates/removes 16 managed project-local agent files
Migration uses only the 16 precise managed basenames (not wildcard deletion)
User-created non-managed agent files are preserved during any migration path
Global ~/.claude/agents sync is idempotent; broken links and stale copies auto-replaced
When global ~/.claude/agents is not writable: explicit error, no silent fallback to project-local
Decision docs and CLAUDE.md updated to reflect global-agents single-source contract
smoke verifies: clean-project init produces 0 project agent files + global source has 16 symlinks
smoke verifies migration: 16 project-local files removed, user files preserved; plain init only warns
subagent_type resolution from global ~/.claude/agents still works post-migration
npm run build still succeeds after all changes
lattice doctor reports agentAssetMode: runtime-owned (execution plan Phase 2 acceptance)
prompt-token-cost-smoke still passes after changes (execution plan Phase 7)
prompt-registry-smoke still passes after changes (execution plan Phase 7)
New projects do not need thin prompt config (.lattice/lattice.json or .Codex/lattice.json) solely to use runtime-owned prompts
features.excluded_by: Story scope is Claude-side global ~/.claude/agents only. Codex-side assetMode config belongs to B-4ee0 (already DONE). This story does not touch .lattice/lattice.json or .Codex/ asset config.

features.feature: Mechanical AgentAssetResolution contract interface (schemaVersion, mode, projectPromptAssets, blockingIssues fields)
features.excluded_by: The execution plan describes this as a phased capability. This story does not introduce the AgentAssetResolution interface schema or doctor/verify command full integration.

features.feature: Full-asset mode remains explicitly supported via lattice init --asset-mode=full or lattice_config_repair --agent-assets=full
features.excluded_by: The execution plan says full-asset mode must not be removed. This story changes only the default. Full-asset explicit mode is pre-existing behavior not changed by this story; CHK-004 adversarial covers user-created files are preserved.

features.feature: Claude and Codex host adapters report prompt source consistently; verify_codex passes without .Codex/agents (Phase 6)
features.excluded_by: Phase 6 (host adapter verification alignment) is a separate planned story per the execution plan recommended story split. Codex adapter is unchanged by this story.

features.feature: STALE_LOCAL_EDIT / CASE_MISMATCH / INCOMPATIBLE prompt files are report-only; Lattice must not overwrite or delete local edits during thin migration
Global-thin mode (default for new projects) requires only .lattice/ assets; no .claude/agents project-local copies required
Legacy full-mode repositories may keep .claude/agents (backward compat)
features.excluded_by: lifecycle-artifact-scope.md explicitly permits legacy full-mode repos to keep .claude/agents. This story removes project-local agent files only for managed basenames on explicit --upgrade; user-created and non-default-mode repos are not touched. CHK-004 adversarial covers managed-basename-only deletion.
